name: Doll shop scam-check signals
description: The ten checks to run against an unfamiliar shop before entering a card number. Built from documented complaint threads, chargeback cases and counterfeit reports — the recurring patterns in them.
limitations: Passing all ten is not a guarantee. It means none of the known patterns fired, not that the shop is safe.
Failing one is not proof of fraud either — it is a reason to look harder before paying.
These describe patterns in reported complaints, not a count of shops.

signals.name: Check the pricing
signals.whatToCheck: Factories set minimum pricing and legitimate vendors sit roughly 10-15% below list. A discount of 50% or more is a counterfeit signal, not a bargain.

signals.name: Verify brand authorization
signals.whatToCheck: The shop should name the factory (WM, Irontech, Zelex, Starpery). Confirm with that factory that the shop is an authorized reseller.

signals.name: Require a factory-photo policy in writing
signals.whatToCheck: The vendor must send photos of your actual doll before dispatch and ship only after you approve.

signals.name: Confirm buyer-protected payment
signals.whatToCheck: PayPal or a credit card must be accepted. Wire transfer, crypto or gift cards only means walk away.

signals.name: Read the review pattern
signals.whatToCheck: Organic reviews mention specifics and include resolved complaints. Walls of invited five-star reviews do not count.

signals.name: Find a real contact surface
signals.whatToCheck: A physical address and a responsive human who answers clearly about lead times and customs.

signals.name: Sanity-check lead times
signals.whatToCheck: Made-to-order dolls take 2-8 weeks. Everything in stock at factory prices is drop-shipping fiction.

signals.name: Reverse-image-search the photos
signals.whatToCheck: Product photos should match the official factory catalogue and not appear across unrelated shops.

signals.name: Read the written policies
signals.whatToCheck: Shipping, customs, cancellation and defect policies must be published before checkout.

signals.name: Check the domain age
signals.whatToCheck: Use any WHOIS lookup. Scam shops churn new domains constantly.
